scripts.check: vp fmt --check && vp run -r check && pnpm lint
scripts.fix: vp fmt && vp run -r check --fix && markdownlint-cli2 --fix && textlint --fix --ignore-path .gitignore '**/*.md' '.cursor/rules/*.mdc'
scripts.lint: markdownlint-cli2 && textlint --ignore-path .gitignore '**/*.md' '.cursor/rules/*.mdc' && cspell --no-progress --dot '**' && secretlint '**/*' && node scripts/typespec.ts && node scripts/actionlint.ts -color && node scripts/zizmor.ts .github/workflows
